<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, viewport-fit=cover" />
  <title>Steaming Vegan Ramen</title>
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }

    html, body {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      overflow: hidden;
      background-color: #070403;

    body {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;

      position: relative;
      cursor: crosshair;
    }

    canvas#scene {
      display: block;
      width: 100vw;
      height: 100vh;
    }

</head>
<body>
  <canvas id="scene" aria-label="Interactive steaming bowl of rich vegan ramen in a dark atmospheric setting"></canvas>

  <script>
    (() => {
      'use strict';

      const canvas = document.getElementById('scene');
      const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d', { alpha: false });

      // Accessibility: respect prefers-reduced-motion dynamically
      const motionQuery = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
      let reducedMotion = motionQuery.matches;
      motionQuery.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
        reducedMotion = e.matches;
      });

      // Deterministic PRNG for procedural textures and organic placement
      function createPRNG(seed = 1337) {
        let s = seed >>> 0;
        return function rand() {
          s = (s + 0x6D2B79F5) >>> 0;
          let t = Math.imul(s ^ (s >>> 15), 1 | s);
          t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
          return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
        };
      }

      // Smooth 2D value/gradient noise for organic broth clouds, ceramic glaze & steam
      const perm = new Uint8Array(512);
      const gradX = new Float32Array(256);
      const gradY = new Float32Array(256);
      {
        const r = createPRNG(90210);
        const p = new Uint8Array(256);
        for (let i = 0; i < 256; i++) {
          p[i] = i;
          const a = r() * Math.PI * 2;
          gradX[i] = Math.cos(a);
          gradY[i] = Math.sin(a);
        }
        for (let i = 255; i > 0; i--) {
          const j = Math.floor(r() * (i + 1));
          const tmp = p[i];
          p[i] = p[j];
          p[j] = tmp;
        }
        for (let i = 0; i < 512; i++) perm[i] = p[i & 255];
      }

      function fade(t) {
        return t * t * t * (t * (t * 6 - 15) + 10);
      }

      function lerp(a, b, t) {
        return a + (b - a) * t;
      }

      function noise2D(x, y) {
        const X = Math.floor(x) & 255;
        const Y = Math.floor(y) & 255;
        const xf = x - Math.floor(x);
        const yf = y - Math.floor(y);
        const u = fade(xf);
        const v = fade(yf);

        const aa = perm[perm[X] + Y];
        const ab = perm[perm[X] + Y + 1];
        const ba = perm[perm[X + 1] + Y];
        const bb = perm[perm[X + 1] + Y + 1];

        const dAA = gradX[aa] * xf + gradY[aa] * yf;
        const dBA = gradX[ba] * (xf - 1) + gradY[ba] * yf;
        const dAB = gradX[ab] * xf + gradY[ab] * (yf - 1);
        const dBB = gradX[bb] * (xf - 1) + gradY[bb] * (yf - 1);

        return lerp(lerp(dAA, dBA, u), lerp(dAB, dBB, u), v);
      }

      function fbm(x, y, octaves = 3) {
        let val = 0;
        let amp = 0.5;
        let freq = 1;
        for (let i = 0; i < octaves; i++) {
          val += amp * noise2D(x * freq, y * freq);
          freq *= 2.03;
          amp *= 0.5;
        }
        return val;
      }

      // Viewport & Scene Metrics
      let width = 0;
      let height = 0;
      let dpr = 1;
      let sceneScale = 1;
      let bowlCenterX = 0;
      let bowlCenterY = 0;

      // Canonical virtual radius of the donburi bowl
      const R = 330;
      const ASPECT = 0.615; // 3D perspective ellipse vertical ratio

      // Interactive pointer state (normalized -1..1 and virtual coordinates)
      const pointer = {
        x: 0,
        y: -0.2,
        targetX: 0,
        targetY: -0.2,
        vx: 0,
        vy: 0,
        prevScreenX: 0,
        prevScreenY: 0,
        virtualX: 0,
        virtualY: 0,
        inBowl: false,
        active: false,
        bobImpulse: 0,
        bobPhase: 0,
        lastRippleTime: 0
      };

      // Offscreen procedural texture caches
      let grainPattern = null;
      let woodLayer = null;
      let bowlBackLayer = null;
      let bowlFrontLipLayer = null;
      let toppingsCache = null;

      // Dynamic simulation entities
      const chiliDroplets = [];
      const mayuWisps = [];
      const floatingGarnish = [];
      const ripples = [];
      const steamPlumes = [];
      const steamPuffs = [];
      const emberMotes = [];
      const noodleStrands = [];
      const cornKernels = [];
      const scallionRings = [];
      const chiliThreads = [];
      const sesameSeeds = [];

      // Hand-thrown organic rim perturbation function
      function rimOffset(angle) {
        return (
          Math.sin(angle * 3 + 0.7) * 2.2 +
          Math.cos(angle * 5 - 1.2) * 1.4 +
          Math.sin(angle * 9 + 2.4) * 0.6
        );
      }

      function traceEllipsePath(c, cx, cy, rx, ry, organic = false, steps = 96) {
        c.beginPath();
        for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
          const a = (i / steps) * Math.PI * 2;
          const dr = organic ? rimOffset(a) : 0;
          const px = cx + Math.cos(a) * (rx + dr);
          const py = cy + Math.sin(a) * (ry + dr * ASPECT);
          if (i === 0) c.moveTo(px, py);
          else c.lineTo(px, py);
        }
        c.closePath();
      }

      // Initialize all procedural culinary elements & particles
      function initSimulationData() {
        const rand = createPRNG(42069);

        // 1. Wavy Alkaline Noodles (Chijire-men) arranged in folded gourmet bundles
        noodleStrands.length = 0;
        const strandCount = 46;
        for (let i = 0; i < strandCount; i++) {
          const depth = i / (strandCount - 1); // 0 = deep in broth, 1 = crowning top
          const bundle = i % 3;
          const baseAngle = bundle === 0 ? -0.18 : bundle === 1 ? 0.12 : -0.04;
          const spread = (rand() - 0.5) * 1.15;
          const startX = -R * 0.56 + rand() * R * 0.34 + (bundle - 1) * 32;
          const startY = -R * 0.14 + spread * R * 0.36;
          const endX = R * 0.32 + rand() * R * 0.32 - (bundle - 1) * 20;
          const endY = R * 0.02 + spread * R * 0.35 + Math.sin(baseAngle) * 40;
          const arch = (rand() - 0.42) * 85;
          const waveFreq = 5.5 + rand() * 3.5;
          const waveAmp = 7 + rand() * 6.5;
          const phase = rand() * Math.PI * 2;
          const thickness = 7.2 + depth * 2.4 + (rand() - 0.5) * 1.2;

          noodleStrands.push({
            startX,
            startY,
            endX,
            endY,
            arch,
            waveFreq,
            waveAmp,
            phase,
            thickness,
            depth,
            submergence: 0.25 + depth * 0.75
          });
        }

        // 2. Sweet Golden Corn Kernels (lower-center right cluster)
        cornKernels.length = 0;
        const cornCenter = { x: R * 0.11, y: R * 0.27 };
        for (let i = 0; i < 48; i++) {
          const rDist = Math.pow(rand(), 0.65) * 68;
          const ang = rand() * Math.PI * 2;
          const kx = cornCenter.x + Math.cos(ang) * rDist * 1.15 + (rand() - 0.5) * 8;
          const ky = cornCenter.y + Math.sin(ang) * rDist * 0.68 + (rand() - 0.5) * 6;
          cornKernels.push({
            x: kx,
            y: ky,
            rot: rand() * Math.PI * 2,
            rx: 6.2 + rand() * 2.4,
            ry: 4.8 + rand() * 1.8,
            shade: rand(),
            submerged: rDist > 52
          });
        }
        cornKernels.sort((a, b) => a.y - b.y);

        // 3. Fresh Sliced Green Scallions (Negi) - central crown + scattered
        scallionRings.length = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < 62; i++) {
          const isCenter = i < 42;
          const rDist = isCenter
            ? Math.pow(rand(), 0.7) * 64
            : 65 + rand() * 145;
          const ang = rand() * Math.PI * 2;
          const sx = (isCenter ? -6 : 0) + Math.cos(ang) * rDist;
          const sy = (isCenter ? -10 : 12) + Math.sin(ang) * rDist * ASPECT;
          scallionRings.push({
            x: sx,
            y: sy,
            rx: 5.5 + rand() * 5.2,
            ry: (3.8 + rand() * 3.8) * (0.72 + rand() * 0.28),
            rot: rand() * Math.PI,
            hueShift: (rand() - 0.5) * 18,
            isFloating: !isCenter
          });
        }

        // 4. Ito-Togarashi (Fine crimson angel-hair chili threads crowning the center)
        chiliThreads.length = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < 34; i++) {
          const cx = -8 + (rand() - 0.5) * 52;
          const cy = -18 + (rand() - 0.5) * 34;
          const len = 24 + rand() * 32;
          const a1 = rand() * Math.PI * 2;
          const a2 = a1 + (rand() - 0.5) * 2.2;
          const a3 = a2 + (rand() - 0.5) * 2.4;
          chiliThreads.push({
            x0: cx - Math.cos(a1) * (len * 0.45),
            y0: cy - Math.sin(a1) * (len * 0.32),
            x1: cx + Math.cos(a2) * (len * 0.25),
            y1: cy + Math.sin(a2) * (len * 0.22) - 6,
            x2: cx + Math.cos(a3) * (len * 0.5),
            y2: cy + Math.sin(a3) * (len * 0.35),
            bright: rand()
          });
        }

        // 5. Toasted White & Black Sesame Seeds (Irori Goma)
        sesameSeeds.length = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < 115; i++) {
          const rDist = Math.pow(rand(), 0.62) * (R * 0.78);
          const ang = rand() * Math.PI * 2;
          sesameSeeds.push({
            x: Math.cos(ang) * rDist,
            y: R * 0.04 + Math.sin(ang) * rDist * ASPECT,
            rot: rand() * Math.PI * 2,
            isBlack: rand() < 0.34,
            scale: 0.8 + rand() * 0.45
          });
        }

        // 6. Floating Chili Oil (Rayu) Droplets with interactive fluid physics
        chiliDroplets.length = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < 78; i++) {
          const ang = rand() * Math.PI * 2;
          // Bias towards broth edges & open pockets between toppings
          const radNorm = 0.22 + Math.pow(rand(), 0.55) * 0.62;
          const bx = Math.cos(ang) * (R * radNorm);
          const by = R * 0.055 + Math.sin(ang) * (R * radNorm * ASPECT);
          const radius = i < 16 ? 7.5 + rand() * 6.5 : 2.2 + Math.pow(rand(), 1.6) * 5.8;
          chiliDroplets.push({
            x: bx,
            y: by,
            homeX: bx,
            homeY: by,
            vx: 0,
            vy: 0,
            r: radius,
            stretch: 0.72 + rand() * 0.22,
            angle: rand() * Math.PI * 2,
            hue: rand() * 14, // rich ruby to burnt tangerine
            phase: rand() * Math.PI * 2
          });
        }

        // 7. Aromatic Black Garlic Oil (Mayu) wisps floating on broth
        mayuWisps.length = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < 24; i++) {
          const ang = rand() * Math.PI * 2;
          const rad = (0.35 + rand() * 0.48) * R;
          mayuWisps.push({
            x: Math.cos(ang) * rad,
            y: R * 0.055 + Math.sin(ang) * rad * ASPECT,
            r: 4 + rand() * 9,
            rot: rand() * Math.PI * 2,
            phase: rand() * Math.PI * 2
          });
        }

        // 8. Floating Micro-Scallions & Sesame on the open broth
        floatingGarnish.length = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < 28; i++) {
          const ang = rand() * Math.PI * 2;
          const rad = (0.28 + rand() * 0.52) * R;
          const gx = Math.cos(ang) * rad;
          const gy = R * 0.055 + Math.sin(ang) * rad * ASPECT;
          floatingGarnish.push({
            x: gx,
            y: gy,
            homeX: gx,
            homeY: gy,
            vx: 0,
            vy: 0,
            type: i < 14 ? 'scallion' : 'sesame',
            r: 3.5 + rand() * 3.2,
            rot: rand() * Math.PI * 2
          });
        }

        // 9. Multi-layered Volumetric Steam Plumes (Spline Ribbons)
        steamPlumes.length = 0;
        const plumeCount = 16;
        for (let i = 0; i < plumeCount; i++) {
          const frac = i / (plumeCount - 1);
          const baseX = (frac - 0.5) * R * 1.45 + (rand() - 0.5) * 35;
          const baseY = (rand() - 0.5) * R * 0.65 * ASPECT;
          const nodes = [];
          const nodeCount = 18;
          for (let j = 0; j < nodeCount; j++) {
            nodes.push({
              x: baseX,
              y: baseY - j * 24,
              vx: 0,
              vy: 0
            });
          }
          steamPlumes.push({
            baseX,
            baseY,
            nodes,
            speed: 0.55 + rand() * 0.45,
            swayAmp: 18 + rand() * 24,
            swayFreq: 0.7 + rand() * 0.7,
            phase: rand() * Math.PI * 2,
            widthBase: 26 + rand() * 28,
            alpha: 0.042 + rand() * 0.038
          });
        }

        // 10. Volumetric Steam Puffs (Billowing clouds reactive to mouse velocity)
        steamPuffs.length = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < 55; i++) {
          steamPuffs.push(createSteamPuff(rand, true));
        }

        // 11. Warm Atmospheric Bokeh / Aroma Motes
        emberMotes.length = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < 32; i++) {
          emberMotes.push({
            x: (rand() - 0.5) * R * 3.4,
            y: (rand() - 0.65) * R * 2.6,
            r: 1.5 + Math.pow(rand(), 2.2) * 18,
            alpha: 0.03 + rand() * 0.12,
            speedY: 0.12 + rand() * 0.35,
            phase: rand() * Math.PI * 2,
            isBokeh: i < 10
          });
        }
      }

      function createSteamPuff(randFn = Math.random, randomAge = false) {
        const angle = randFn() * Math.PI * 2;
        const dist = Math.pow(randFn(), 0.7) * R * 0.76;
        const startX = Math.cos(angle) * dist;
        const startY = R * 0.03 + Math.sin(angle) * dist * ASPECT;
        const progress = randomAge ? randFn() : 0;
        return {
          x: startX + (randFn() - 0.5) * progress * 70,
          y: startY - progress * 430,
          originX: startX,
          originY: startY,
          vx: (randFn() - 0.5) * 0.3,
          vy: -(0.75 + randFn() * 0.85),
          r: 34 + randFn() * 44,
          life: progress,
          lifeSpeed: 0.0022 + randFn() * 0.0022,
          seed: randFn() * 100
        };
      }

      // Build subtle film grain pattern once
      function buildGrainPattern() {
        const gCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        gCanvas.width = 128;
        gCanvas.height = 128;
        const gCtx = gCanvas.getContext('2d');
        const img = gCtx.createImageData(128, 128);
        const data = img.data;
        const rand = createPRNG(777);
        for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i += 4) {
          const v = Math.floor(rand() * 255);
          data[i] = v;
          data[i + 1] = Math.floor(v * 0.92);
          data[i + 2] = Math.floor(v * 0.82);
          data[i + 3] = 9; // subtle warm grain
        }
        gCtx.putImageData(img, 0, 0);
        grainPattern = ctx.createPattern(gCanvas, 'repeat');
      }

      // Build cached offscreen layers for intricate surface textures
      function buildOffscreenCaches() {
        const cacheSize = 960;
        const half = cacheSize / 2;

        // 1. Bowl Back & Outer Body Layer
        bowlBackLayer = document.createElement('canvas');
        bowlBackLayer.width = cacheSize;
        bowlBackLayer.height = cacheSize;
        const bCtx = bowlBackLayer.getContext('2d');
        bCtx.translate(half, half);
        renderBowlBackAndBodyToCache(bCtx);

        // 2. Bowl Front Lip Layer (overlaps foreground broth edge)
        bowlFrontLipLayer = document.createElement('canvas');
        bowlFrontLipLayer.width = cacheSize;
        bowlFrontLipLayer.height = cacheSize;
        const fCtx = bowlFrontLipLayer.getContext('2d');
        fCtx.translate(half, half);
        renderBowlFrontLipToCache(fCtx);

        // 3. Detailed Toppings Sprite Cache (Mushrooms, Nori, Bok Choy, Menma, Vegan Ajitama)
        toppingsCache = {};
        toppingsCache.nori = buildNoriLayer();
        toppingsCache.mushrooms = buildMushroomsLayer();
        toppingsCache.bokChoy = buildBokChoyLayer();
        toppingsCache.menma = buildMenmaLayer();
        toppingsCache.ajitama = buildAjitamaLayer();
      }

      function renderBowlBackAndBodyToCache(c) {
        const rand = createPRNG(101);
        const rx = R;
        const ry = R * ASPECT;
        const footRx = R * 0.45;
        const footRy = footRx * ASPECT;
        const footY = R * 0.56;

        // Deep multi-layered ambient occlusion shadow on the wooden counter
        for (let i = 4; i >= 0; i--) {
          const sScale = 1 + i * 0.14;
          const sGrad = c.createRadialGradient(
            8, footY - 12, footRx * 0.2,
            12, footY + 6, footRx * 1.95 * sScale
          );
          sGrad.addColorStop(0, `rgba(2, 1, 0, ${0.42 - i * 0.06})`);
          sGrad.addColorStop(0.55, `rgba(12, 5, 2, ${0.26 - i * 0.04})`);
          sGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
          c.fillStyle = sGrad;
          c.beginPath();
          c.ellipse(10, footY + 4, footRx * 2.05 * sScale, footRy * 1.95 * sScale, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          c.fill();
        }

        // Ceramic Kodai (Bowl Foot Ring)
        c.save();
        c.beginPath();
        c.ellipse(0, footY + 14, footRx, footRy, 0, 0, Math.PI);
        c.lineTo(-footRx, footY - 10);
        c.ellipse(0, footY - 10, footRx, footRy, 0, Math.PI, 0, true);
        c.closePath();
        const footGrad = c.createLinearGradient(-footRx, 0, footRx, 0);
        footGrad.addColorStop(0, '#2a1c14');
        footGrad.addColorStop(0.28, '#543b2b');
        footGrad.addColorStop(0.65, '#241811');
        footGrad.addColorStop(1, '#120b08');
        c.fillStyle = footGrad;
        c.fill();

        // Unglazed raw clay bottom rim accent
        c.strokeStyle = '#6e4e38';
        c.lineWidth = 2.5;
        c.beginPath();
        c.ellipse(0, footY + 13, footRx * 0.99, footRy * 0.99, 0, 0.08, Math.PI - 0.08);
        c.stroke();
        c.restore();

        // Outer Handcrafted Donburi Belly (Curved 3D profile)
        c.save();
        c.beginPath();
        c.moveTo(-rx, 0);
        c.bezierCurveTo(
          -rx * 0.99, R * 0.36,
          -footRx * 1.38, footY - 2,
          -footRx, footY - 4
        );
        c.ellipse(0, footY - 4, footRx, footRy, 0, Math.PI, 0, true);
        c.bezierCurveTo(
          footRx * 1.38, footY - 2,
          rx * 0.99, R * 0.36,
          rx, 0
        );
        c.closePath();
        c.clip();

        // Rich Kuro-Raku / Tenmoku dark stoneware glaze gradient
        const bodyGrad = c.createRadialGradient(-rx * 0.38, -R * 0.1, R * 0.08, 0, R * 0.25, R * 1.15);
        bodyGrad.addColorStop(0, '#3d2c24');
        bodyGrad.addColorStop(0.28, '#231915');
        bodyGrad.addColorStop(0.62, '#130d0b');
        bodyGrad.addColorStop(0.88, '#0b0706');
        bodyGrad.addColorStop(1, '#1c120d');
        c.fillStyle = bodyGrad;
        c.fillRect(-rx - 20, -20, rx * 2 + 40, footY + footRy + 40);

        // Potter's wheel horizontal throwing ridges (Rokuro lines)
        for (let i = 1; i <= 14; i++) {
          const t = i / 15;
          const ringY = t * (footY - 12);
          const ringRx = lerp(rx, footRx * 1.08, Math.pow(t, 1.35));
          const ringRy = ringRx * ASPECT;
          c.beginPath();
          c.ellipse(0, ringY, ringRx, ringRy, 0, 0.05, Math.PI - 0.05);
          c.strokeStyle = i % 2 === 0
            ? 'rgba(255, 195, 140, 0.045)'
            : 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35)';
          c.lineWidth = 2.2;
          c.stroke();
        }

        // Artisanal iron-spot glaze speckles on outer bowl
        for (let i = 0; i < 420; i++) {
          const sx = (rand() - 0.5) * rx * 2;
          const sy = rand() * (footY + footRy);
          const sr = 0.6 + rand() * 1.8;
          c.fillStyle = rand() > 0.4
            ? `rgba(185, 125, 78, ${0.06 + rand() * 0.12})`
            : `rgba(8, 4, 2, ${0.25 + rand() * 0.3})`;
          c.beginPath();
          c.arc(sx, sy, sr, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          c.fill();
        }

        // Subtle crimson-gold lacquer brushstroke accent on front-left belly
        const brushGrad = c.createLinearGradient(-rx * 0.75, R * 0.18, -rx * 0.05, R * 0.38);
        brushGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(140, 38, 18, 0)');
        brushGrad.addColorStop(0.35, 'rgba(155, 45, 20, 0.24)');
        brushGrad.addColorStop(0.7, 'rgba(185, 110, 42, 0.15)');
        brushGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(140, 38, 18, 0)');
        c.strokeStyle = brushGrad;
        c.lineWidth = 18;
        c.lineCap = 'round';
        c.beginPath();
        c.ellipse(0, R * 0.15, rx * 0.88, ry * 0.88, 0, Math.PI * 0.56, Math.PI * 0.88);
        c.stroke();

        c.restore();

        // Outer Rim Path & Inner Ceramic Wall
        c.save();
        traceEllipsePath(c, 0, 0, rx, ry, true, 128);
        const rimBaseGrad = c.createLinearGradient(-rx, -ry, rx, ry);
        rimBaseGrad.addColorStop(0, '#593d2b');
        rimBaseGrad.addColorStop(0.35, '#2e1f17');
        rimBaseGrad.addColorStop(0.7, '#1a110d');
        rimBaseGrad.addColorStop(1, '#3b281d');
        c.fillStyle = rimBaseGrad;

          const dr = rimOffset(a);

          const py = Math.sin(a) * (ry + dr * ASPECT) + 4;

      // Draw Wavy Golden Alkaline Noodles (Chijire-men) with Subsurface Broth Depth & Wet Specular Sheen
      function drawNoodles(c, time, lightX, lightY) {
        c.save();
        const bRx = R * 0.88;
        const bRy = bRx * ASPECT;
        const bCy = R * 0.055;
        traceEllipsePath(c, 0, bCy, bRx, bRy, false, 72);
        c.clip();

        // Warm subsurface ambient shadow under the noodle mound
        const moundShadow = c.createRadialGradient(-18, 28, 15, -10, 28, R * 0.58);
        moundShadow.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(72, 18, 2, 0.52)');
        moundShadow.addColorStop(0.65, 'rgba(85, 24, 3, 0.25)');
        moundShadow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(85, 24, 3, 0)');
        c.fillStyle = moundShadow;
        c.beginPath();
        c.ellipse(-12, 26, R * 0.58, R * 0.36, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        c.fill();

        const animPhase = reducedMotion ? 0 : time * 1.35;

        for (let i = 0; i < noodleStrands.length; i++) {
          const ns = noodleStrands[i];
          const steps = 22;
          const pts = [];

          const dx = ns.endX - ns.startX;
          const dy = ns.endY - ns.startY;
          const len = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
          const nx = -dy / len;
          const ny = dx / len;

          for (let s = 0; s <= steps; s++) {
            const t = s / steps;
            const env = Math.sin(t * Math.PI); // tapers at submerged ends
            const wave = Math.sin(t * ns.waveFreq * Math.PI + ns.phase + animPhase * 0.35) * ns.waveAmp * env;
            const archOffset = Math.sin(t * Math.PI) * ns.arch;
            const px = lerp(ns.startX, ns.endX, t) + nx * (wave + archOffset * 0.35);
            const py = lerp(ns.startY, ns.endY, t) + ny * (wave * 0.72 + archOffset * 0.65);
            pts.push({ x: px, y: py });
          }

          const traceStrand = (offsetX = 0, offsetY = 0) => {
            c.beginPath();
            c.moveTo(pts[0].x + offsetX, pts[0].y + offsetY);
            for (let s = 1; s < pts.length - 1; s++) {
              const xc = (pts[s].x + pts[s + 1].x) * 0.5 + offsetX;
              const yc = (pts[s].y + pts[s + 1].y) * 0.5 + offsetY;
              c.quadraticCurveTo(pts[s].x + offsetX, pts[s].y + offsetY, xc, yc);
            }
            const last = pts[pts.length - 1];
            c.lineTo(last.x + offsetX, last.y + offsetY);
          };

          c.lineCap = 'round';
          c.lineJoin = 'round';

          // 1. Deep broth-submerged shadow/border
          traceStrand(1.2, 2.6);
          c.strokeStyle = `rgba(92, 26, 3, ${0.42 + (1 - ns.depth) * 0.25})`;
          c.lineWidth = ns.thickness + 3.2;
          c.stroke();

          // 2. Golden alkaline noodle body
          traceStrand(0, 0);
          const nGrad = c.createLinearGradient(ns.startX, ns.startY, ns.endX, ns.endY);
          const bright = 0.72 + ns.depth * 0.28;
          const rCol = Math.round(238 * bright);
          const gCol = Math.round(182 * bright);
          const bCol = Math.round(76 * bright);
          nGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(182, 92, 22, 0.45)');
          nGrad.addColorStop(0.2, `rgb(${rCol - 18}, ${gCol - 24}, ${bCol - 18})`);
          nGrad.addColorStop(0.5, `rgb(${Math.min(255, rCol + 12)}, ${Math.min(255, gCol + 16)}, ${Math.min(255, bCol + 22)})`);
          nGrad.addColorStop(0.8, `rgb(${rCol - 14}, ${gCol - 20}, ${bCol - 14})`);
          nGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(175, 86, 18, 0.45)');
          c.strokeStyle = nGrad;
          c.lineWidth = ns.thickness;
          c.stroke();

          // 3. Wet glossy specular highlight along top-left noodle crest (for emergent strands)
          if (ns.depth > 0.32) {
            traceStrand(-0.8 + lightX * 1.1, -1.3 + lightY * 0.9);
            const specAlpha = (ns.depth - 0.3) * 0.68;
            const specGrad = c.createLinearGradient(ns.startX, ns.startY, ns.endX, ns.endY);
            specGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 248, 225, 0)');
            specGrad.addColorStop(0.28, `rgba(255, 248, 225, ${specAlpha * 0.7})`);
            specGrad.addColorStop(0.52, `rgba(255, 252, 240, ${specAlpha})`);

      // Update Physics for Broth Ripples, Floating Chili Oil & Volumetric Steam
      function updateSimulation(time, dt) {
        // Smooth pointer interpolation
        pointer.x += (pointer.targetX - pointer.x) * Math.min(1, dt * 8);
        pointer.y += (pointer.targetY - pointer.y) * Math.min(1, dt * 8);
        pointer.vx *= 0.9;
        pointer.vy *= 0.9;

        // Spring decay for topping buoyancy impulse (on click/tap)
        if (pointer.bobImpulse > 0.001) {
          pointer.bobImpulse *= Math.exp(-dt * 2.8);
          pointer.bobPhase += dt * 11;
        } else {
          pointer.bobImpulse = 0;
        }

        // Autonomous gentle simmer ripples
        if (!reducedMotion && Math.random() < dt * 1.4 && ripples.length < 10) {
          const ang = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
          const dist = Math.random() * R * 0.62;
          ripples.push({
            x: Math.cos(ang) * dist,
            y: R * 0.055 + Math.sin(ang) * dist * ASPECT,
            minR: 4,
            maxR: 48 + Math.random() * 45,
            age: 0,
            maxAge: 2.2 + Math.random() * 1.2,
            strength: 0.45 + Math.random() * 0.35
          });
        }

        for (let i = ripples.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
          ripples[i].age += dt;
          if (ripples[i].age >= ripples[i].maxAge) {
            ripples.splice(i, 1);
          }
        }

        // Update Floating Chili Oil Pearls (Rayu) & Garnish
        const bRx = R * 0.84;
        const bRy = bRx * ASPECT;
        const bCy = R * 0.055;

        for (let i = 0; i < chiliDroplets.length; i++) {
          const d = chiliDroplets[i];
          if (!reducedMotion) {
            // Subtle thermal convection swirl
            const swirlX = Math.cos(time * 0.55 + d.phase) * 0.14;
            const swirlY = Math.sin(time * 0.45 + d.phase) * 0.09;
            d.vx += swirlX * dt * 15;
            d.vy += swirlY * dt * 15;
          }

          // Interactive cursor stirring in broth
          if (pointer.active && pointer.inBowl) {
            const dx = d.x - pointer.virtualX;
            const dy = (d.y - pointer.virtualY) / ASPECT;
            const distSq = dx * dx + dy * dy;
            const interactRad = 105;
            if (distSq < interactRad * interactRad && distSq > 1) {
              const dist = Math.sqrt(distSq);
              const falloff = (1 - dist / interactRad);
              // Push radially + impart pointer velocity swirl
              d.vx += ((dx / dist) * 28 + pointer.vx * 0.45) * falloff * dt;
              d.vy += ((dy / dist) * 18 + pointer.vy * 0.45) * falloff * dt;
            }
          }

          // Gentle spring return toward home pocket so broth stays balanced
          d.vx += (d.homeX - d.x) * 0.65 * dt;
          d.vy += (d.homeY - d.y) * 0.65 * dt;

          d.vx *= 0.92;
          d.vy *= 0.92;
          d.x += d.vx;
          d.y += d.vy;

          // Keep inside broth boundary ellipse
          const nx = d.x / bRx;
          const ny = (d.y - bCy) / bRy;
          const normDist = Math.hypot(nx, ny);
          if (normDist > 0.97) {
            d.x = (nx / normDist) * bRx * 0.96;
            d.y = bCy + (ny / normDist) * bRy * 0.96;
            d.vx *= -0.4;
            d.vy *= -0.4;
          }
        }

        // Update floating micro-garnish
        for (let i = 0; i < floatingGarnish.length; i++) {
          const fg = floatingGarnish[i];
          if (pointer.active && pointer.inBowl) {
            const dx = fg.x - pointer.virtualX;
            const dy = (fg.y - pointer.virtualY) / ASPECT;
            const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
            if (dist < 95 && dist > 1) {
              const f = (1 - dist / 95) * dt * 22;
              fg.vx += (dx / dist) * f + pointer.vx * 0.015;
              fg.vy += (dy / dist) * f * ASPECT + pointer.vy * 0.015;
            }
          }
          fg.vx += (fg.homeX - fg.x) * 0.8 * dt;
          fg.vy += (fg.homeY - fg.y) * 0.8 * dt;
          fg.vx *= 0.9;
          fg.vy *= 0.9;
          fg.x += fg.vx;
          fg.y += fg.vy;
        }

        // Update Multi-Layered Steam Plumes (Spline Ribbons)
        for (let i = 0; i < steamPlumes.length; i++) {
          const pl = steamPlumes[i];
          const nodes = pl.nodes;
          nodes[0].x = pl.baseX;
          nodes[0].y = pl.baseY;

          for (let j = 1; j < nodes.length; j++) {
            const frac = j / (nodes.length - 1);
            const targetY = pl.baseY - j * 24.5;
            const curlSway = reducedMotion
              ? Math.sin(frac * 3.8 + pl.phase) * pl.swayAmp * frac
              : Math.sin(frac * 4.2 - time * pl.speed * 2.1 + pl.phase) * pl.swayAmp * Math.pow(frac, 0.85) +
                Math.cos(frac * 2.3 - time * pl.speed * 1.3 + pl.phase * 1.7) * (pl.swayAmp * 0.45) * frac;

            const targetX = pl.baseX + curlSway + pointer.x * 22 * frac;

            const n = nodes[j];
            // Mouse cursor parts & swirls the rising steam ribbons
            if (pointer.active) {
              const dx = n.x - pointer.virtualX;
              const dy = n.y - pointer.virtualY;
              const distSq = dx * dx + dy * dy;
              const r = 135;
              if (distSq < r * r && distSq > 1) {
                const dist = Math.sqrt(distSq);
                const push = Math.pow(1 - dist / r, 1.5);
                n.vx += ((dx / dist) * 140 + pointer.vx * 2.4) * push * dt;
                n.vy += ((dy / dist) * 75 + pointer.vy * 1.6) * push * dt;
              }
            }

            n.vx += (targetX - n.x) * 3.2 * dt;
            n.vy += (targetY - n.y) * 3.8 * dt;
            n.vx *= 0.88;
            n.vy *= 0.88;
            n.x += n.vx;
            n.y += n.vy;
          }
        }

        // Update Volumetric Steam Puffs
        if (!reducedMotion) {
          for (let i = 0; i < steamPuffs.length; i++) {
            const p = steamPuffs[i];
            p.life += p.lifeSpeed * (dt * 60);
            if (p.life >= 1) {
              Object.assign(p, createSteamPuff(Math.random, false));
              continue;
            }

            const curl = noise2D(p.x * 0.006 + p.seed, p.y * 0.006 - time * 0.25);
            p.vx += curl * 0.065;

            if (pointer.active) {
              const dx = p.x - pointer.virtualX;
              const dy = p.y - pointer.virtualY;
              const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
              if (dist < 140 && dist > 1) {
                const f = Math.pow(1 - dist / 140, 1.4);
                p.vx += ((dx / dist) * 2.2 + pointer.vx * 0.05) * f;
                p.vy += ((dy / dist) * 1.2 + pointer.vy * 0.04) * f;
              }
            }

            p.vx *= 0.96;
            p.vy = lerp(p.vy, -(0.85 + p.life * 0.65), 0.05);
            p.x += p.vx * (dt * 60);
            p.y += p.vy * (dt * 60);
          }

          // Update background warm motes / bokeh
          for (let i = 0; i < emberMotes.length; i++) {
            const m = emberMotes[i];
            m.y -= m.speedY * (dt * 60);
            m.x += Math.sin(time * 0.7 + m.phase) * 0.18;
            if (m.y < -R * 1.6) {
              m.y = R * 1.1;
            }
          }
        }
      }

            for (let j = 1; j < nodes.length - 1; j++) {
              const xc = (nodes[j].x + nodes[j + 1].x) * 0.5;
              const yc = (nodes[j].y + nodes[j + 1].y) * 0.5;
              c.quadraticCurveTo(nodes[j].x, nodes[j].y, xc, yc);
            }
            c.lineTo(topNode.x, topNode.y);

            const alphaScale = pass === 0 ? 1.0 : 0.72;
            const a = pl.alpha * alphaScale;
            const sGrad = c.createLinearGradient(pl.baseX, pl.baseY, topNode.x, topNode.y);
            sGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 212, 168, 0)');
            sGrad.addColorStop(0.16, `rgba(255, 224, 188, ${a * 1.15})`);
            sGrad.addColorStop(0.48, `rgba(248, 232, 214, ${a})`);
            sGrad.addColorStop(0.82, `rgba(225, 222, 228, ${a * 0.45})`);
            sGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(215, 215, 225, 0)');

            c.strokeStyle = sGrad;
            c.lineWidth = pass === 0 ? pl.widthBase * 1.85 : pl.widthBase * 0.62;
            c.stroke();
          }
        }

        // 3. Soft Volumetric Vapor Puffs
        for (let i = 0; i < steamPuffs.length; i++) {
          const p = steamPuffs[i];
          const env = Math.sin(p.life * Math.PI);
          const alpha = env * (1 - p.life * 0.45) * 0.052;
          if (alpha <= 0.002) continue;

          const rad = p.r * (0.75 + p.life * 1.35);
          const pGrad = c.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, rad * 0.08, p.x, p.y, rad);

          // Warm golden-peach near the bowl, shifting to ethereal pale cream higher up
          const rCol = Math.round(lerp(255, 232, p.life));
          const gCol = Math.round(lerp(218, 226, p.life));
          const bCol = Math.round(lerp(182, 232, p.life));

          pGrad.addColorStop(0, `rgba(${rCol}, ${gCol}, ${bCol}, ${alpha})`);
          pGrad.addColorStop(0.52, `rgba(${rCol}, ${gCol}, ${bCol}, ${alpha * 0.45})`);
          pGrad.addColorStop(1, `rgba(${rCol}, ${gCol}, ${bCol}, 0)`);

          c.fillStyle = pGrad;
          c.beginPath();
          c.arc(p.x, p.y, rad, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          c.fill();
        }

        c.restore();
      }

      // Draw Dynamic Specular Rim Highlights & Interactive Lantern Glow
      function drawDynamicLighting(c, lightX, lightY) {
        c.save();
        c.globalCompositeOperation = 'screen';

        // 1. Dynamic Specular Glaze Highlight sliding along the ceramic rim
        const lightAngle = Math.atan2(lightY - 0.35, lightX - 0.25);
        const rx = R * 0.972;
        const ry = rx * ASPECT;

        c.beginPath();
        const arcSpan = 0.68;
        const steps = 42;
        for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
          const t = i / steps;
          const a = lightAngle - arcSpan * 0.5 + t * arcSpan;
          const dr = rimOffset(a);
          const px = Math.cos(a) * (rx + dr);
          const py = Math.sin(a) * (ry + dr * ASPECT);
          if (i === 0) c.moveTo(px, py);
          else c.lineTo(px, py);
        }
        c.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 224, 175, 0.26)';
        c.lineWidth = 4.2;
        c.lineCap = 'round';
        c.stroke();

        // Secondary opposite rim fill highlight
        c.beginPath();
        const oppAngle = lightAngle + Math.PI;
        for (let i = 0; i <= 32; i++) {
          const t = i / 32;
          const a = oppAngle - 0.4 + t * 0.8;
          const dr = rimOffset(a);
          const px = Math.cos(a) * (rx + dr);
          const py = Math.sin(a) * (ry + dr * ASPECT) + 2;
          if (i === 0) c.moveTo(px, py);
          else c.lineTo(px, py);
        }
        c.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 195, 132, 0.16)';
        c.lineWidth = 3.0;
        c.stroke();

        // 2. Warm Ambient Lantern Glow tracking the pointer softly
        const glowX = lightX * R * 0.55;
        const glowY = lightY * R * 0.42 - R * 0.12;
        const lanternGlow = c.createRadialGradient(glowX, glowY, R * 0.05, glowX, glowY, R * 1.45);
        lanternGlow.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 168, 82, 0.09)');
        lanternGlow.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(218, 98, 32, 0.04)');
        lanternGlow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
        c.fillStyle = lanternGlow;
        c.beginPath();
        c.arc(glowX, glowY, R * 1.45, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        c.fill();

        c.restore();
      }

      // Main Frame Render Loop
      let lastTime = performance.now();

      function render(now) {
        const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - lastTime) / 1000);
        lastTime = now;
        const time = now * 0.001;

        updateSimulation(time, dt);

        // 1. Draw Cached Dark Wood & Izakaya Backdrop
        ctx.drawImage(woodLayer, 0, 0);

        // 2. Transform into Responsive Virtual Bowl Space
        ctx.save();
        const px = pointer.x;
        const py = pointer.y;

        // Subtle 3D camera parallax response
        const camOffsetX = px * 9 * sceneScale;
        const camOffsetY = py * 6 * sceneScale;
        ctx.translate(bowlCenterX + camOffsetX, bowlCenterY + camOffsetY);
        ctx.scale(sceneScale, sceneScale);

        // Background Warm Bokeh & Floating Aroma Motes
        ctx.save();
        ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'screen';
        for (let i = 0; i < emberMotes.length; i++) {
          const m = emberMotes[i];
          const mGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(m.x, m.y, 0.2, m.x, m.y, m.r);
          mGrad.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255, 196, 122, ${m.alpha})`);
          mGrad.addColorStop(0.6, `rgba(235, 128, 52, ${m.alpha * 0.4})`);
          mGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(235, 128, 52, 0)');
          ctx.fillStyle = mGrad;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(m.x, m.y, m.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
        }
        ctx.restore();

        // 3. Draw Handcrafted Ceramic Donburi Back & Outer Body
        ctx.drawImage(bowlBackLayer, -480, -480);

        // 4. Draw Smoked Bamboo Chopsticks & River-Stone Rest in Foreground
        drawChopsticks(ctx, px, py);

        // Spring buoyancy bob offset when user clicks/stirs the bowl
        const breathBob = reducedMotion ? 0 : Math.sin(time * 1.6) * 0.9;
        const impulseBob = Math.sin(pointer.bobPhase) * pointer.bobImpulse * 6.5;
        const bobY = breathBob + impulseBob;

        // 5. Draw Rich Creamy Vegan Broth Base
        drawBrothBase(ctx, time, px, py);

        // 6. Draw Crispy Roasted Nori Sheets (tucked inside back-right rim)
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(R * 0.42 + px * 2.5, -R * 0.22 + py * 1.8 + bobY * 0.35);
        ctx.drawImage(toppingsCache.nori, -210, -220);
        ctx.restore();

        // 7. Draw Wavy Golden Alkaline Noodles (Chijire-men)
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(px * 1.8, py * 1.4 + bobY * 0.55);
        drawNoodles(ctx, time, px, py);
        ctx.restore();

        // 8. Draw Gourmet Vegan Toppings (with individual depth parallax & buoyancy)
        // 8a. Char-Kissed Baby Bok Choy (Right side)
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(R * 0.32 + px * 2.8, -R * 0.01 + py * 2.0 + bobY * 0.65);
        ctx.drawImage(toppingsCache.bokChoy, -210, -210);
        ctx.restore();

        // 8b. Seared Diamond-Scored King Oyster Mushrooms & Star-Cut Shiitake (Upper-left & back)
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(-R * 0.16 + px * 3.1, -R * 0.08 + py * 2.2 + bobY * 0.72);
        ctx.drawImage(toppingsCache.mushrooms, -280, -220);
        ctx.restore();

        // 8c. Fermented Bamboo Shoots (Menma, lower-left)
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(-R * 0.44 + px * 2.6, R * 0.16 + py * 1.9 + bobY * 0.6);
        ctx.drawImage(toppingsCache.menma, -170, -140);
        ctx.restore();

        // 8d. Sweet Golden Corn Cluster (Lower-center right)
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(px * 2.4, py * 1.8 + bobY * 0.65);
        drawCornCluster(ctx, px, py);
        ctx.restore();

        // 8e. Soy-Marinated Vegan Jammy "Ajitama" Halves
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(-R * 0.02 + px * 3.4, R * 0.06 + py * 2.5 + bobY * 0.85);
        ctx.drawImage(toppingsCache.ajitama, -230, -170);
        ctx.restore();

        // 9. Draw Interactive Broth Ripples, Floating Chili Oil (Rayu) & Micro-Garnish
        drawBrothSurfaceDetails(ctx, time, px, py);

        // 10. Draw Crowning Scallion Mound (Negi), Sesame Seeds & Ito-Togarashi Chili Threads
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(px * 3.8, py * 2.8 + bobY * 0.9);
        drawCrownGarnish(ctx, px, py);
        ctx.restore();

        // 11. Draw Front Lip of the Donburi Bowl (overlapping foreground broth edge)
        ctx.drawImage(bowlFrontLipLayer, -480, -480);

        // 12. Draw Ceramic Renge (Soup Spoon) Hooking Over the Lower-Right Rim
        drawRengeSpoon(ctx, px, py, bobY);

        // 13. Draw Dynamic Specular Rim Highlights & Lantern Glow
        drawDynamicLighting(ctx, px, py);

        // 14. Draw Multi-Layered Volumetric Steam & Heat Haze
        drawSteamAndAtmosphere(ctx, time);

        ctx.restore();

        // 15. Subtle Cinematic Vignette & Warm Procedural Grain
        const vigGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
          width * 0.5, height * 0.52, Math.min(width, height) * 0.34,
          width * 0.5, height * 0.52, Math.max(width, height) * 0.78
        );
        vigGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
        vigGrad.addColorStop(0.72, 'rgba(5, 2, 1, 0.28)');
        vigGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(2, 1, 0, 0.74)');
        ctx.fillStyle = vigGrad;
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

        if (grainPattern) {
          ctx.fillStyle = grainPattern;
          ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
        }

        requestAnimationFrame(render);
      }

      // Responsive Resize Handler
      function handleResize() {
        dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2.5);
        width = Math.max(1, Math.floor(window.innerWidth * dpr));
        height = Math.max(1, Math.floor(window.innerHeight * dpr));
        canvas.width = width;
        canvas.height = height;

        // Fit the bowl & rising steam comfortably on any screen aspect ratio
        const minDim = Math.min(width, height);
        const aspect = width / height;
        if (aspect < 0.78) {
          // Mobile portrait: scale by width with comfortable side margins
          sceneScale = (width * 0.84) / (R * 2.15);
          bowlCenterY = height * 0.58;
        } else if (aspect > 1.8) {
          // Ultrawide desktop
          sceneScale = (height * 0.82) / (R * 1.95);
          bowlCenterY = height * 0.57;
        } else {
          sceneScale = (minDim * 0.84) / (R * 2.02);
          bowlCenterY = height * 0.575;
        }
        bowlCenterX = width * 0.5;

        buildWoodBackgroundLayer();
      }

      // Interactive Mouse / Touch Handlers
      function updatePointerFromClient(clientX, clientY) {
        const screenX = clientX * dpr;
        const screenY = clientY * dpr;

        const normX = (clientX / window.innerWidth) * 2 - 1;
        const normY = (clientY / window.innerHeight) * 2 - 1;
        pointer.targetX = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, normX));
        pointer.targetY = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, normY));

        const vx = (screenX - pointer.prevScreenX) / sceneScale;
        const vy = (screenY - pointer.prevScreenY) / sceneScale;
        pointer.vx = Math.max(-45, Math.min(45, vx));
        pointer.vy = Math.max(-45, Math.min(45, vy));
        pointer.prevScreenX = screenX;
        pointer.prevScreenY = screenY;

        pointer.virtualX = (screenX - bowlCenterX) / sceneScale;
        pointer.virtualY = (screenY - bowlCenterY) / sceneScale;
        pointer.active = true;

        // Check if cursor is hovering over the broth ellipse
        const bRx = R * 0.88;
        const bRy = bRx * ASPECT;
        const bCy = R * 0.055;
        const ex = pointer.virtualX / bRx;
        const ey = (pointer.virtualY - bCy) / bRy;
        pointer.inBowl = (ex * ex + ey * ey) <= 1.02;

        // Spawn gentle trailing broth ripples when moving across the soup
        const now = performance.now();
        const speed = Math.hypot(pointer.vx, pointer.vy);
        if (pointer.inBowl && speed > 1.8 && now - pointer.lastRippleTime > 95 && ripples.length < 16) {
          pointer.lastRippleTime = now;
          ripples.push({
            x: pointer.virtualX,
            y: pointer.virtualY,
            minR: 3,
            maxR: 34 + Math.min(45, speed * 2.2),
            age: 0,
            maxAge: 1.45,
            strength: Math.min(0.85, 0.35 + speed * 0.03)
          });
        }
      }

      function triggerBrothImpulse(clientX, clientY) {
        updatePointerFromClient(clientX, clientY);
        pointer.bobImpulse = 1.0;

        // Create concentric warm broth wave & aroma steam burst
        const rx = pointer.inBowl ? pointer.virtualX : 0;
        const ry = pointer.inBowl ? pointer.virtualY : R * 0.055;

        ripples.push({
          x: rx,
          y: ry,
          minR: 6,
          maxR: 115,
          age: 0,
          maxAge: 1.9,
          strength: 0.95
        });

        // Radial nudge to nearby chili oil droplets
        for (let i = 0; i < chiliDroplets.length; i++) {
          const d = chiliDroplets[i];
          const dx = d.x - rx;
          const dy = (d.y - ry) / ASPECT;
          const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
          if (dist < 160 && dist > 1) {
            const push = (1 - dist / 160) * 8.5;
            d.vx += (dx / dist) * push;
            d.vy += (dy / dist) * push * ASPECT;
          }
        }
      }

      window.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
        updatePointerFromClient(e.clientX, e.clientY);
      }, { passive: true });

      window.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
        triggerBrothImpulse(e.clientX, e.clientY);
      }, { passive: true });

      window.addEventListener('pointerleave', () => {
        pointer.active = false;
        pointer.inBowl = false;
        pointer.targetX = 0;
        pointer.targetY = -0.15;
      }, { passive: true });

      window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize, { passive: true });

      // Initialize & Start Scene
      initSimulationData();
      buildGrainPattern();
      buildOffscreenCaches();
      handleResize();
      requestAnimationFrame(render);
    })();
  </script>
